description: A DOL case found without its number, from what someone knows about it: any of the employer's name, words of the job title and the law firm, with one filing day, a range of days or no date. One of them is enough. Each case comes with its number, status, job title and filing day, and the answer says what DOL's record holds for the days read. PERM by default. The program may be pwd (prevailing wage), lca (H-1B) or seasonal (H-2A, H-2B, CW-1). A law firm finds decided cases only, since DOL names it at the decision. A range longer than three months needs an employer or a firm. With no employer fitting in a month or less it returns the employers that filed in those days under a close spelling. Examples: {"employer": "Acme Robotics", "filed": "2026-01-30"}, {"job": "controls engineer", "from": "2026-01-05", "to": "2026-02-28"}.

filed.description: One filing day, YYYY-MM-DD. Not with from or to.

firm.description: The law firm's or agent's name. Decided cases only.

from.description: The first filing day of a range, YYYY-MM-DD.

program.description: perm (the default), pwd, lca or seasonal.

to.description: The last filing day of a range, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: find_case
title: Find a case without its number
